pages.text: "I'll finish first!" Mina took a big bite of flatbread. On a rainy day, Mom, Mina, and Sonu ate lunch inside.
"When I'm done, the spinning top first..." Chewing made Mina stop speaking. Sonu chewed a small piece.
Mina chewed for a long time. The untouched top lay nearby. Mina saw Sonu tearing off little pieces to eat.
After swallowing, Mina said, "I bit off too much." Mom showed a small piece. "Try this much next time."
Mom lightly touched Mina's cheek. "Rushing kept you from tasting it, didn't it?" Mina nodded. "I'll try a little this time."
Mom displayed the piece on her palm. "No need to hurry. The top is right here." Sonu pushed it aside.
Mina tore off a small piece and chewed carefully. The more they chewed, the nuttier it tasted. "Small Bites, Chew Well!"
Mina ate the last bite. Mom cleared the empty plate. "Eating slowly tastes good." Mina smiled.
Mina picked up the top, then set it before Sonu. "Let's spin it together when you're done." Sonu nodded.
After the meal, the children spun the top beside Mom. "Sonu's turn now!" The top whirled around.
